description.0: A colossal sword as weighty as a ship's anchor. Legend has it that it once belonged to the founder of Port Belovodye.

0.0: The equipping character's ATK is increased by <cryo>16%</cryo>, and they gain "Attendant's Measure" for <cryo>15s</cryo>: When their Electro attacks hit opponents, the Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by your active character is increased by <cryo>20%</cryo>. While this effect is active, hits from the equipping character's attacks that are considered to deal Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG enhance the effect, granting the equipping character an additional <cryo>16%</cryo> ATK and your active character an additional <cryo>20%</cryo> Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG. These effects can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
